videos.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
videos.description: In this episode of Bible Q&A, our panel addresses thoughtful questions such as: Why are we born sinners while Jesus was not? How do we know what Jesus prayed in Gethsemane? What is spiritual apathy, and how can we overcome it? We’ll also explore topics like Cain and Abel’s lineage, the serpent’s curse, being “unequally yoked,” whether loved ones can appear as angels, the tongues of angels, confessing sins, and which Bible is truly the original. Join us as we turn to Scripture for clear, faith-building answers.

videos.title: 3ABN Worship Hour
videos.description: In this 3ABN production, Shelley Quinn presents a powerful Bible message on how to walk in the light of Christ in a dark world. Discover why Christians must stay connected to Jesus Christ through God’s Word, prayer, surrender, and the Holy Spirit for power to overcome; how Christ living within us makes His light visible through our character, words, and actions; and why believers must refuse to let the darkness of the world dim their spiritual light. Learn how “Christ in you, the hope of glory” transforms us so that we can radiate Jesus to the world.

videos.description: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this new 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.

videos.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
videos.description: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.
